verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a hosted scraping API, and whether a SaaS of this kind publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows the service's source is available or licensed openly. The GitHub-hosted CLI is a client tool with no license stated, so it does not count as the product's source being open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
